fields.System.Title: CNT-501 — Freeze the warehouse
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller running a full count, I want all stock movement stopped, so
that the count is a snapshot of one moment rather than a moving target.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the freeze is applied, then no receipt, pick, putaway, replenishment, or
  • adjustment can be confirmed.
  • - Given in-flight tasks at freeze time, then they must be completed or cancelled before
  • the freeze takes effect, and the list is shown.
  • - Given a transfer dispatching or arriving, then it is blocked for the duration.
  • - Given the freeze, then a full snapshot of every balance is captured.
  • - Given a frozen warehouse, then any blocked attempt returns a clear message naming the
  • freeze.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory, all task modules |
| Tables | freeze state, balance snapshot |
| Risks | Incomplete freeze contaminating every variance ([doc 09 §6.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration (one per blocked operation) |
